name: iphone-use
description: Wireless iPhone control for Codex through a Mac: unplug the USB cable after pairing and setup.

interface.shortDescription: Control your iPhone over Wi-Fi after initial pairing.
interface.longDescription: Operate a real iPhone wirelessly from Codex using your Mac and a prepared RemoteXPC tunnel. Complete initial pairing and signing with your own Apple account, then unplug USB and use components first. Requires macOS, Xcode, a reachable paired iPhone, and a valid WDA signature; no cross-network relay is included.
defaultPrompt: Set up iphone-use-wireless for wireless control on this Mac.
Use iphone-use-wireless to connect to my iPhone over Wi-Fi and read its current screen.
